prompt: Create a production 3D-rendered-to-2D game sprite sheet matching the attached approved concept's sculptural stylized fantasy quality. Transparent RGBA background, absolutely no ground, shadow, haze, text, labels, borders or other characters. EXACTLY SIX separate full-body sequential walking animation frames arranged in a precise 3-column by 2-row grid, 1536 by 1024 image, each cell 512 by 512. Orthographic slightly overhead camera, face and shoulders aimed straight downward toward the viewer, consistent top-left lighting and IDENTICAL character proportions/equipment across frames. A smooth LOW-STEP two-stride walk loop: 1 right foot contacts front/left foot trails; 2 right foot planted and left passes close; 3 left foot swings forward/right pushes; 4 left foot contacts front/right trails; 5 left foot planted/right passes; 6 right swings forward/left pushes. Knees not marching high, feet alternate, hips bob minimally, no pose repeats and no horizontal center drift. Common ground projection in every cell at x256,y448. Full silhouette must remain inside x40..472,y24..492, feet fully visible; equipment stays in the same hand. Body casting no shadow; runtime uses separate grounded shadow. Keep facial expression and materials the same in all six cells. Only the approved third creature in top row: stocky brown-furred hyena gnoll guard with a short broad canine muzzle, round ears and a bristly crest, heavy blue-gray steel chest armor and shoulder plates, leather boots, a small sturdy round shield in LEFT hand (viewer right) and a short spear in RIGHT hand. Clear upright biped walk; shield never covers both feet or face.

finalRevision.promptSummary: 沿用铁鬃卫士外形、盔甲和手持武器，重画 3 列 2 行六个向下行走姿势，左右支撑腿交替、低幅迈步、固定俯视角及身体比例；不复制旧的同脚迈步，去掉地面和烘焙阴影，输出真正透明底。此为最终编辑指令摘要，原始生成提示词保留在上方 prompt。
